what_happened: Dispatch scoped 4 READMEs for cols=files-lines wrap. Verified on a scratch copy that Expressiveness/README.md and WeakCanonical/README.md wrap cleanly (4-col header rewrite + cols=files-lines + stripped duplicate (N files) prose). But Kamp/README.md and NfMultiAnchorBridge/README.md use a single aggregated 'loose modules' row (all loose .lean files summed into one row) that no existing generator option can reproduce: rows=subdirs silently drops the row entirely (confirmed by experiment -- no INV FAIL, just gone), and rows=both expands it into 33-49 individual per-file rows, a structural rewrite far beyond a header/option change. Per NON-GOALS, reporting and stopping rather than extending the generator; recommend these two stay unwrapped under this task.

Full scratch-copy verification loop for the 2 in-scope wraps succeeded end to end on the first attempt: wrapped Expressiveness/README.md and WeakCanonical/README.md with a 4-column header (Module/Files/Lines/Description) and cols=files-lines, ran --emit-inventory, confirmed every subdirectory total rendered as a real number (no em-dash), confirmed via key-sorted diff that every description was preserved byte-for-byte except the 10 deliberately-stripped '(N files)' parentheticals, then corrupted one count, confirmed INV FAIL named exactly that file, restored via --emit-inventory (never a pathspec checkout), and confirmed the restored file byte-matched the pre-corruption state.
